description: Android activity class `PreviewActivity` that displays a preview of images or text files based on a URI received via intent. It uses Glide for image loading and handles MIME types to determine preview capability.

classes.name: PreviewActivity
classes.description: Android activity responsible for displaying a preview of an image or text file based on a URI passed via intent. Handles MIME type detection and dynamically adds views to the layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the activity, retrieves the URI from intent extras, determines MIME type, and displays appropriate preview or message.
